players.product: Sovereign AI GPU cloud (TIR AI/ML platform) on NVIDIA H100, H200 and B200 GPUs for model training, fine-tuning and inference

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 FY2027 results (CFO Nitin Jain): revenue up 411% year-on-year and 43% quarter-on-quarter (the absolute quarterly revenue figure is garbled in the call transcript); EBITDA INR 1,750 million, up 45% quarter-on-quarter, margin 76.6% (up 141 basis points vs Q1); profit before tax INR 971 million (INR 586 million in Q1); PAT INR 727 million (INR 439 million), PAT margin 32.5% (28%). H1 FY2027 revenue INR 3,805 million, up 376%; H1 EBITDA INR 2,894 million at 76%, 2.3 times full-year FY2026 EBITDA; H1 PBT INR 1,558 million vs a loss of INR 252 million. Drivers: the Blackwell GPUs and higher average utilization.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue +411% YoY, +43% QoQ; EBITDA INR 1,750 million (76.6% margin); PAT INR 727 million; H1 revenue INR 3,805 million (+376%)

quarterly_data.signal: MD Tarun Dua: E2E signed a nearly INR 1,000 crore deal with a sovereign AI company for the Blackwell chip lasting through June 2029, converting the existing B200 capacity from pay-as-you-go to a multi-year contract; the flagship flexible capacity is fully utilized under that contract, improving long-term revenue visibility. Revenue mix in the quarter (CFO): IndiaAI customers roughly 13%-15% and international customers roughly 20%-25%; the MD says these percentages swing widely.
quarterly_data.figure: nearly INR 1,000 crore contract through June 2029; IndiaAI customers roughly 13%-15%; international roughly 20%-25%

quarterly_data.signal: MD Tarun Dua: the next lot of 1,024 B200 GPUs, already announced, is expected to go live this quarter; nothing has been decided yet about contracting it; plans for B300 and Vera Rubin will be announced once they firm up. He sees no insurmountable GPU supply-chain challenges in the near or medium term and says the software is meant to be compatible with other chip makers' accelerators if customers require it.
quarterly_data.figure: 1,024 B200 GPUs expected to go live this quarter

quarterly_data.signal: MD Tarun Dua: E2E sees itself as a 70%-plus EBITDA margin business over the medium and long term and gives no guidance; the majority of its GPUs run on its own platform (TIR and Jarvislabs) with very little bare metal sold, part of the GPU fleet is used internally for platform R&D, and inference products Blaze and Endpoints have been soft-released, with the official launch a few weeks away.
